authored_by: main-session (not a subagent); three TDD agents correctly refused to fabricate this file
seed_rationale: Fixed date-derived seed. Frozen at policy v1. Any change to this value requires a new policy_version so a re-split can never be passed off as the original split.
status_note: Evidence qualifiers such as MODEL_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED are labels only and never promote to VERIFIED (design map line 921).

provenance.note: Every number below was measured from on-disk artifacts in this session, not copied from prior prose.
provenance.qid_set_identity: queries == qrels == sol-review == sol-review-pass-a == sol-review-pass-b (all five files carry the identical 180-qid set)

dev.definition: Queries that have been observed, tuned against, scored, or reviewed. Metrics computed on dev are exploratory and are never release evidence.
dev.membership_rule: every qid present in data/eval/techdocs/queries.text.jsonl as of policy v1
dev.lock_reason: All 180 appear as the denominator of three retrieval bake-off reports and both Sol review passes. Exposure is irreversible: a query cannot become unseen.

holdout.definition: Queries never observed by any tuning, scoring, or review run. Only holdout metrics may carry release weight.
holdout.blocked_reason: All 180 existing queries are provably seen, so after the permanent dev lock there is no unseen population left to sample. Resampling or renumbering the same 180 queries would be contamination laundering, not a holdout.
explicitly_forbidden_constructions: resampling any subset of the 180 dev qids and relabelling it holdout
renumbering or paraphrasing dev queries to make them look new
treating the 17 pure-negative qids as a holdout because they lack positive qrels
using dev metrics as a holdout proxy under any name
unblock_requirements: author net-new queries against corpus documents not referenced by dev qrels (143 of the active corpus docs are referenced; the untouched remainder is the only legitimate pool)
produce gold labels for those queries through a review path that records real model identity per design map E2 / section 26
register the new qids in a policy v2 with its own seed and hash manifest
never expose the new queries to any tuning or scoring run before the holdout evaluation

strata.note: Verified distributions, recorded so any future v2 split can be stratified against the real shape rather than an assumed one.

corpus_source_pins.note: Real revisions parsed from qrels document_id values, not placeholders.

firewall.purpose: An agent under evaluation may read the question and the corpus. It must never reach the answer, the label, or any prior score.
firewall.enforcement_note: A path that matches no rule is DENIED, not allowed. Denial must raise, never silently return empty.

denied_reason_codes.QRELS: relevance labels are the answer key
denied_reason_codes.REPORTS: prior scores leak which queries are hard and what was retrieved
denied_reason_codes.HOLDOUT: future holdout membership must stay hidden
denied_reason_codes.TESTS_SOURCE: benchmark test source reveals expected behaviour

manifest.qid_hash_rule: sha256 of newline-joined, lexicographically sorted qids with a single trailing newline, UTF-8 encoded
manifest.empty_set_hash_rule: the empty holdout hashes the empty byte string; the manifest must additionally carry holdout_status=BLOCKED so an empty hash can never be mistaken for a computed set
manifest.generated_before_run_note: The manifest must exist and validate before any scoring run starts, so a split cannot be chosen after seeing results.

failure_semantics.condition: policy bytes do not match the recorded sha256 sidecar
policy_version is not a version this code understands
any caller asks for a holdout metric while holdout_size == 0
failure_semantics.forbidden_fallback: return 0.0, 1.0, None, or an empty report that reads like a measurement

failure_semantics.condition: any caller tries to mark holdout status VERIFIED while holdout_size == 0
any qid appears in both dev and holdout
a dev qid from policy v1 is missing from a later split
failure_semantics.forbidden_fallback: quietly drop it so scores improve

failure_semantics.condition: an evaluated agent requests a denied path
failure_semantics.forbidden_fallback: return empty content as if the file were blank

failure_semantics.condition: requested path matches neither allow nor deny list
manifest policy_sha256 does not match the current policy file
